items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wouldn’t have known her last name.

ctx.x: And I think maybe, yeah I think that that’s... I never worked at the Half Note or the Five Spot. I think I subbed at the Five Spot once in the cloak room, but it was such a small cloak room. I didn’t like it.
At Basin Street when you were there did you ever meet Phoebe Jacobs? Was she, no?
What, did she work in the cloak room?
